# Does microbiome status impact gene co-expression network topology?

This analysis is focussed on asking whether microbes couple and uncouple biological processes (i.e. co-expression networks). The thinking behind this is that if a certain microbe or metabolite in SPF is responsible for directing certain gene expression profiles in a certain direction then changing the community could in theory uncouple these processes - this would usually be processes that are across different cell types I would have thought but that wouldn't have to be the case.


```{r loading data, echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Ileum
ileum_counts_spf <- as.data.frame(ileum_normed_dat_corrected[, grep("^Ileum(1[0-5]|[1-9])$", colnames(ileum_normed_dat_corrected))])

## need to change the rownames to gene symbols 

ileum_counts_spf <- process_deseq_results(ileum_counts_spf, offline = TRUE)
ileum_counts_spf <- ileum_counts_spf$res[1:(length(ileum_counts_spf$res)-1)]
ileum_counts_spf_subset <- ileum_counts_spf[rownames(ileum_counts_spf) %in% rownames(results$Ileum_SPF_vs_GF$deseq), ]
ileum_counts_spf_subset <- ileum_counts_spf_subset[1:(length(ileum_counts_spf_subset)-1)]
ileum_counts_t_spf <- t(ileum_counts_spf_subset)


# Liver
liver_counts_spf <- as.data.frame(liver_normed_dat[, grep("^Liver(1[0-5]|[1-9])$", colnames(liver_normed_dat))])

## need to change the rownames to gene symbols 
liver_counts_spf <- process_deseq_results(liver_counts_spf, offline = TRUE)
liver_counts_spf <- liver_counts_spf$res[1:(length(liver_counts_spf$res)-1)]
liver_counts_spf_subset <- liver_counts_spf[rownames(liver_counts_spf) %in% rownames(results$Liver_SPF_vs_GF$deseq), ]
liver_counts_spf_subset <- liver_counts_spf_subset[1:(length(liver_counts_spf_subset)-1)]
liver_counts_t_spf <- t(liver_counts_spf_subset)


```

Using a soft power threshhold of 7 and 5 in the ileum and liver respectively (Fig X, A), we were able to calculate initial module eigengenes and modules which were over 80% similar were merged to reduce the number of redundant modules (Fig X, B) in the SPF mice alone.

```{r wgcna ileum, echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

gsg_spf <- goodSamplesGenes(ileum_counts_t_spf)

if (!gsg_spf$allOK) {
  if (sum(!gsg_spf$goodGenes) > 0) 
    printFlush(paste("Removing genes:", paste(names(ileum_counts_t_spf)[!gsg_spf$goodGenes], collapse = ", ")))
  if (sum(!gsg_spf$goodSamples) > 0)
    printFlush(paste("Removing samples:", paste(rownames(ileum_counts_t_spf)[!gsg_spf$goodSamples], collapse = ", ")))
  
  ileum_counts_t_spf <- ileum_counts_t_spf[gsg_spf$goodSamples, gsg_spf$goodGenes]
}

spt_spf <- pickSoftThreshold(ileum_counts_t_spf)
softPower_spf <- 7
adjacency_spf <- adjacency(ileum_counts_t_spf, power = softPower_spf, type = 'signed')

TOM_spf <- TOMsimilarity(adjacency_spf)
TOM_spf.dissimilarity <- 1 - TOM_spf

geneTree_spf <- hclust(as.dist(TOM_spf.dissimilarity), method = "average")
Modules_spf <- cutreeDynamic(dendro = geneTree_spf, distM = TOM_spf.dissimilarity, deepSplit = 4, pamRespectsDendro = FALSE, minClusterSize = 100)
ModuleColors_spf <- labels2colors(Modules_spf)

MElist_spf <- moduleEigengenes(ileum_counts_t_spf, colors = ModuleColors_spf)
MEs_spf <- MElist_spf$eigengenes

ME_spf.dissimilarity <- 1 - cor(MEs_spf, use = "complete")
METree_spf <- hclust(as.dist(ME_spf.dissimilarity), method = "average")

merge_spf <- mergeCloseModules(ileum_counts_t_spf, ModuleColors_spf, cutHeight = 0.2)
mergedColors_spf <- merge_spf$colors
mergedMEs_spf <- merge_spf$newMEs

# create a simple mapping of module and gene
ileum_modules_df <- data.frame(gene = colnames(ileum_counts_t_spf),
                         module = mergedColors_spf)

write.table(ileum_modules_df,
            file = "export.dir/ileum_modules_df.tsv",
            sep = "\t",
            quote = FALSE,
            row.names = FALSE)

# getkMEs for module membership - correlation with MEs
ileum_kMEs <- as.data.frame(WGCNA::cor(ileum_counts_t_spf, mergedMEs_spf, use = "p"))

# write out the module eigengenes
write.table(data.frame(sample = rownames(mergedMEs_spf), mergedMEs_spf),
            file = "export.dir/ileum_mes.tsv",
            sep = "\t",
            row.names = FALSE,
            quote = FALSE)

```
```{r wgcna liver, echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

gsg_spf <- goodSamplesGenes(liver_counts_t_spf)

if (!gsg_spf$allOK) {

ModuleColors_spf_liver <- labels2colors(Modules_spf_liver)

MElist_spf_liver <- moduleEigengenes(liver_counts_t_spf, colors = ModuleColors_spf_liver)

ME_spf_liver.dissimilarity <- 1 - cor(MEs_spf_liver, use = "complete")

            row.names = FALSE,
            quote = FALSE)

### faceted version
combined_data <- bind_rows(
  spt_spf$fitIndices %>% mutate(tissue = "Ileum"),
  spt_spf_liver$fitIndices %>% mutate(tissue = "Liver")
) %>%
  select(Power, SFT.R.sq, mean.k., tissue) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(SFT.R.sq, mean.k.), 
               names_to = "metric", 
               values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    metric_label = case_when(
      metric == "SFT.R.sq" ~ "Scale-Free Topology Fit",
      metric == "mean.k." ~ "Mean Connectivity"
    ),
    y_label = case_when(
      metric == "SFT.R.sq" ~ "R²",
      metric == "mean.k." ~ "Connectivity"
    )
  )

ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = Power, y = value)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Power), color = "red", size = 6) +
  geom_hline(data = filter(combined_data, metric == "SFT.R.sq", tissue == "Ileum"), 
             aes(yintercept = 0.70), color = "red") +
  geom_hline(data = filter(combined_data, metric == "SFT.R.sq", tissue == "Liver"), 
             aes(yintercept = 0.80), color = "red") +
  facet_grid(metric_label ~ tissue, scales = "free_y", 
             labeller = labeller(metric_label = label_value, tissue = label_value)) +
  labs(x = "Soft Threshold", y = "") +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold")
  )

```

## Functional enrichment

Here we look at performing functional enrichments on each module. This gives us a general picture of the co-expressed modules.


```{r enrichments in SPF, echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# For ileum data
ileum_results <- analyzeModuleData(mergedColors_spf, ileum_counts_t_spf, "Ileum")

# For liver data
liver_results <- analyzeModuleData(mergedColors_spf_liver, liver_counts_t_spf, "Liver")
```

## Highest correlations in modules

```{r correlations within modules, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

ileum_cors <- list()
modules <- unique(ileum_modules_df$module)
for (i in 1:length(modules)){
  genes <- ileum_modules_df$gene[ileum_modules_df$module == modules[i]]
  all_cors <- cor(ileum_counts_t_spf[,genes])
  all_cors <- OCMSutility::sym_mat2df(all_cors)
  all_cors$module <- modules[i]
  all_cors <- all_cors[order(all_cors$value, decreasing = TRUE),]
  ileum_cors[[i]] <- all_cors
}
ileum_cors <- bind_rows(ileum_cors)

# liver
liver_cors <- list()
liver_modules <- unique(liver_modules_df$module)
for (i in 1:length(liver_modules)){
  genes <- liver_modules_df$gene[liver_modules_df$module == liver_modules[i]]
  all_cors <- cor(liver_counts_t_spf[,genes])
  all_cors <- OCMSutility::sym_mat2df(all_cors)
  all_cors$module <- liver_modules[i]
  all_cors <- all_cors[order(all_cors$value, decreasing = TRUE),]
  liver_cors[[i]] <- all_cors
}
liver_cors <- bind_rows(liver_cors)
```

### Average correlations (median connectivity) and variance explained along PC1

```{r median connectivity, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

# ileum
ileum_median_cors <- list()
for (i in modules){
  median_cor <- median(ileum_cors$value[ileum_cors$X1 != ileum_cors$X2 & ileum_cors$module == i])
  ileum_median_cors[[i]] <- median_cor
}

liver_median_cors <- list()
for (i in liver_modules){
  median_cor <- median(liver_cors$value[liver_cors$X1 != liver_cors$X2 & liver_cors$module == i])
  liver_median_cors[[i]] <- median_cor
}

## PC1 instead ie. variance explained for each module

# Ileum
ileum_pc1 <- list()
for (i in modules){
  genes <- ileum_modules_df$gene[ileum_modules_df$module == i]
  pc <- prcomp(ileum_counts_t_spf[,genes])
  var_explained <- pc$sdev^2
  pve_pc1 <- var_explained[1] / sum(var_explained)
  ileum_pc1[[i]] <- pve_pc1
}

# Liver
liver_pc1 <- list()
for (i in liver_modules){
  genes <- liver_modules_df$gene[liver_modules_df$module == i]
  pc <- prcomp(liver_counts_t_spf[,genes])
  var_explained <- pc$sdev^2
  pve_pc1 <- var_explained[1] / sum(var_explained)
  liver_pc1[[i]] <- pve_pc1
}

# add to gene set size
ileum_stats$Module <- as.character(ileum_stats$Module)
ileum_stats$module <- gsub(".*- ", "", ileum_stats$Module)
ileum_stats$PC1_VE <- unlist(ileum_pc1[ileum_stats$module], use.names = FALSE)

liver_stats$module <- gsub(".*- ", "", liver_stats$Module)
liver_stats$PC1_VE <- unlist(liver_pc1[liver_stats$module], use.names = FALSE)

ileum_module_colors <- unique(ileum_stats$module)
names(ileum_module_colors) <- unique(ileum_stats$module)

ileum_stats <- ileum_stats[order(ileum_stats$PC1_VE, decreasing = TRUE),]
ileum_stats$Module <- factor(ileum_stats$Module, levels = ileum_stats$Module)
ggplot(ileum_stats, aes(x = Module, y = PC1_VE, size = Number_of_Genes, color = module)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = ileum_module_colors) +
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(0.95, 0.95)) +
  guides(color = "none")
ggsave("export.dir/ileum_ngenes_connectivity_modules.pdf", height = 2.5, width = 5)



liver_stats$Module <- factor(liver_stats$Module, levels = liver_stats$Module)
ggplot(liver_stats, aes(x = Module, y = Number_of_Genes, size = PC1_VE)) +
  geom_point(color = "#9E0142") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
ggsave("export.dir/liver_ngenes_connectivity_modules.pdf", height = 2.5, width = 5)

```


## Preservation

Next we look at how well the modules are preserved in GF and MM12 mice - this is using the built-in WGCNA preservation statistics and we are using the overall Z-score as a guide.

```{r module preservation ileum, echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

allowWGCNAThreads(nThreads = 14)

if (!file.exists("export.dir/ileum_preservation.Rds")){

# ==============================================================================
# DATA PREPROCESSING
# ==============================================================================

ileum_counts_all <- as.data.frame(ileum_normed_dat_corrected)
ileum_counts_all <- process_deseq_results(ileum_counts_all, offline = TRUE)
ileum_counts_all <- ileum_counts_all$res[1:(length(ileum_counts_all$res)-1)]
ileum_counts_all <- ileum_counts_all[1:(length(ileum_counts_all)-1)]
ileum_counts_all <- ileum_counts_all[rowSums(ileum_counts_all >= 10) >= 15, ]

# ==============================================================================
# SAMPLE EXTRACTION
# ==============================================================================

spf_samples_ileum <- ileum_metadata$sampleID[ileum_metadata$age == 'Young' & 
                                       ileum_metadata$group == 'Solo' &
                                       ileum_metadata$status == "SPF"]

gf_samples_ileum <- ileum_metadata$sampleID[ileum_metadata$age == 'Young' & 
                                      ileum_metadata$group == 'Solo' &
                                      ileum_metadata$status == "GF"]

mm12_samples_ileum <- ileum_metadata$sampleID[ileum_metadata$age == 'Young' & 
                                        ileum_metadata$group == 'Solo' &
                                        ileum_metadata$status == "MM12"]

extract_group_data <- function(expr_data, sample_ids) {
  return(expr_data[, sample_ids])
}

spf_data_ileum  <- extract_group_data(ileum_counts_all, spf_samples_ileum)
gf_data_ileum  <- extract_group_data(ileum_counts_all, gf_samples_ileum)
mm12_data_ileum  <- extract_group_data(ileum_counts_all, mm12_samples_ileum)


# ==============================================================================
# MODULE PRESERVATION ANALYSIS
# ==============================================================================

# Test preservation in GF
multiExpr_gf_ileum <- list(
  SPF = list(data = ileum_counts_t_spf),
  GF = list(data = t(gf_data_ileum))
)
multiColor_spf <- list(SPF = mergedColors_spf)

mp_spf_to_gf_ileum <- modulePreservation(
  multiExpr_gf_ileum,
  multiColor_spf,
  referenceNetworks = 1,
  networkType = "signed",
  nPermutations = 500,
  randomSeed = 1,
  parallelCalculation = TRUE,
  verbose = 3
)

# Test preservation in MM12
multiExpr_mm12_ileum <- list(
  SPF = list(data = ileum_counts_t_spf),
  MM12 = list(data = t(mm12_data_ileum))
)

mp_spf_to_mm12_ileum <- modulePreservation(
  multiExpr_mm12_ileum,
  multiColor_spf,
  referenceNetworks = 1,
  networkType = "signed",
  nPermutations = 500,
  parallelCalculation = TRUE,
  randomSeed = 1,
  verbose = 3
)
# ==============================================================================
# EXTRACT PRESERVATION STATISTICS
# ==============================================================================

stats_gf_ileum <- mp_spf_to_gf_ileum$preservation$Z$ref.SPF$inColumnsAlsoPresentIn.GF
stats_mm12_ileum <- mp_spf_to_mm12_ileum$preservation$Z$ref.SPF$inColumnsAlsoPresentIn.MM12

# Create comprehensive preservation comparison dataframe
preservation_comparison_ileum <- data.frame(
  Module = rownames(stats_gf_ileum),
  ModuleSize = stats_gf_ileum[, "moduleSize"],
  Z_GF = stats_gf_ileum[, "Zsummary.pres"],
  Z_MM12 = stats_mm12_ileum[, "Zsummary.pres"],
  GF_Coexpression = stats_gf_ileum[, "Zdensity.pres"],
  GF_HubStability = stats_gf_ileum[, "Zconnectivity.pres"],
  MM12_Coexpression = stats_mm12_ileum[, "Zdensity.pres"],
  MM12_HubStability = stats_mm12_ileum[, "Zconnectivity.pres"]
)

# Add GO terms
module_descriptions_ileum <- setNames(ileum_results$module_terms$GOterm, ileum_results$module_terms$Module)
preservation_comparison_ileum$GOterm <- module_descriptions_ileum[preservation_comparison_ileum$Module]

saveRDS(preservation_comparison_ileum, file = "export.dir/ileum_preservation.Rds")

# ==============================================================================
# DATA PREPROCESSING
# ==============================================================================

liver_counts_all <- as.data.frame(liver_normed_dat)
liver_counts_all <- process_deseq_results(liver_counts_all, offline = TRUE)
liver_counts_all <- liver_counts_all$res[1:(length(liver_counts_all$res)-1)]
liver_counts_all <- liver_counts_all[1:(length(liver_counts_all)-1)]
liver_counts_all <- liver_counts_all[rowSums(liver_counts_all >= 10) >= 15, ]

# ==============================================================================
# SAMPLE EXTRACTION
# ==============================================================================

spf_samples_liver <- liver_metadata$sampleID[liver_metadata$age == 'Young' & 
                                       liver_metadata$group == 'Solo' &
                                       liver_metadata$status == "SPF"]

gf_samples_liver <- liver_metadata$sampleID[liver_metadata$age == 'Young' & 
                                      liver_metadata$group == 'Solo' &
                                      liver_metadata$status == "GF"]

mm12_samples_liver <- liver_metadata$sampleID[liver_metadata$age == 'Young' & 
                                        liver_metadata$group == 'Solo' &
                                        liver_metadata$status == "MM12"]

spf_data_liver <- extract_group_data(liver_counts_all, spf_samples_liver)
gf_data_liver <- extract_group_data(liver_counts_all, gf_samples_liver)
mm12_data_liver <- extract_group_data(liver_counts_all, mm12_samples_liver)


# ==============================================================================
# MODULE PRESERVATION ANALYSIS
# ==============================================================================

# Test preservation in GF
multiExpr_gf_liver <- list(
  SPF = list(data = liver_counts_t_spf),
  GF = list(data = t(gf_data_liver))
)
multiColor_spf <- list(SPF = mergedColors_spf_liver)

mp_spf_to_gf_liver <- modulePreservation(
  multiExpr_gf_liver,
  multiColor_spf,
  referenceNetworks = 1,
  networkType = "signed",
  nPermutations = 500,
  randomSeed = 1,
  parallelCalculation = TRUE,
  verbose = 3
)

# Test preservation in MM12
multiExpr_mm12_liver <- list(
  SPF = list(data = liver_counts_t_spf),
  MM12 = list(data = t(mm12_data_liver))
)

mp_spf_to_mm12_liver <- modulePreservation(
  multiExpr_mm12_liver,
  multiColor_spf,
  referenceNetworks = 1,
  networkType = "signed",
  nPermutations = 500,
  randomSeed = 1,
  parallelCalculation = TRUE,
  verbose = 3
)

# ==============================================================================
# EXTRACT PRESERVATION STATISTICS
# ==============================================================================

stats_gf_liver <- mp_spf_to_gf_liver$preservation$Z$ref.SPF$inColumnsAlsoPresentIn.GF
stats_mm12_liver <- mp_spf_to_mm12_liver$preservation$Z$ref.SPF$inColumnsAlsoPresentIn.MM12

# Create comprehensive preservation comparison dataframe
preservation_comparison_liver <- data.frame(
  Module = rownames(stats_gf_liver),
  ModuleSize = stats_gf_liver[, "moduleSize"],
  Z_GF = stats_gf_liver[, "Zsummary.pres"],
  Z_MM12 = stats_mm12_liver[, "Zsummary.pres"],
  GF_Coexpression = stats_gf_liver[, "Zdensity.pres"],
  GF_HubStability = stats_gf_liver[, "Zconnectivity.pres"],
  MM12_Coexpression = stats_mm12_liver[, "Zdensity.pres"],
  MM12_HubStability = stats_mm12_liver[, "Zconnectivity.pres"]
)

# Add GO terms
module_descriptions_liver <- setNames(liver_results$module_terms$GOterm, liver_results$module_terms$Module)
preservation_comparison_liver$GOterm <- module_descriptions_liver[preservation_comparison_liver$Module]
saveRDS(preservation_comparison_liver, file = "export.dir/liver_preservation.Rds")

}else{
  preservation_comparison_ileum <- readRDS("export.dir/ileum_preservation.Rds")
  preservation_comparison_liver <- readRDS("export.dir/liver_preservation.Rds")}

## Interesting module associations

The scatterplot looks super interesting in that the green module is preserved in the MM12 but not in germ-free, whereas darkgreen is not preserved in either. We have observed some interesting associations with F. duncaniae later on in the analysis and so do want to understand these modules a bit better - should we be looking at all of the genes or subsets that have functional associations. This has not been completely clear so far as different sub modules of genes will show different patterns.

Here we will look at how the different module graphs look for modules of interest across microbiome states.

### Ileum

#### Green module

Green module looks very interesting as it is more preserved in teh MM12 than in the GF. 


```{r green module, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

  column_to_rownames(var = "Group.1")

## Changes in connectivity

It's very interesting to visualise the changes in network connectivity across the microbiome states but is slightly confusing that the black module which appears quite well preserved is not particularly well preserved when looking at the RNA splicing related genes. There is a bit of a question as to whether this is a network comparison issue in general and should look into this a bit more.


```{r fatty acid metabolism genes connectivity, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

to_compare_green_cors <- data.frame(SPF = spf_cors$r,
                                    MM12 = mm12_cors$r,
                                    GF = gf_cors$r) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything())

median_spf <- median(to_compare_green_cors$value[to_compare_green_cors$name == "SPF"], na.rm = TRUE)
median_gf <- median(to_compare_green_cors$value[to_compare_green_cors$name == "GF"], na.rm = TRUE)
median_mm12 <- median(to_compare_green_cors$value[to_compare_green_cors$name == "MM12"], na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(to_compare_green_cors, aes(x = value, fill = name)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(median_spf, median_mm12, median_gf),
             color = c(group_colours[["SPF"]],
                       group_colours[["MM12"]],
                       group_colours[["GF"]]),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5, color = "white") +
 # geom_jitter(height = 0, width = 0.1) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colours)  +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave("export.dir/green_module_cors_across_groups.pdf", height = 2.5, width = 2.5)

```


## Testing significance of differences

We can test if the correlations between each gene pair is significantly different between groups by using confidence intervals and whether or not they overlap. We can pick out some key examples from this analysis.

```{r fatty acid cis, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

ci_fa <- na.omit(compare_cor_ci(t(ileum_exprs_all[green_gois,]),
               group = ileum_metadata[colnames(ileum_exprs_all),]$status))

ci_fa[order(ci_fa$r, decreasing = TRUE),] 

fa_gois <- c("Apoc2", "Apoc3", "Apoa4", "Acat1", "Faah", "Acaah", "Fabp1")

apoc2_apoc3 <- ci_fa[ci_fa$x == "Apoc2" & ci_fa$y == "Apoc3",]
apoc2_apoc3_p <- ggplot(apoc2_apoc3, aes(x = group, y = r, color = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_segment(x = c(1,2,3), y = apoc2_apoc3$lower_ci, xend = c(1,2,3), yend = apoc2_apoc3$upper_ci) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colours) +
  ylim(c(-0.7, 1))

apoc2_apoa4 <- ci_fa[ci_fa$x == "Apoc2" & ci_fa$y == "Apoa4",]

  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_segment(x = c(1,2,3), y = apoc2_apoa4$lower_ci, xend = c(1,2,3), yend = apoc2_apoa4$upper_ci) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colours) +
  ylim(c(-0.5, 1))

apoa4_fabp1 <- ci_fa[ci_fa$x == "Apoa4" & ci_fa$y == "Fabp1",]
apoa4_fabp1_p <- ggplot(apoa4_fabp1, aes(x = group, y = r, color = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_segment(x = c(1,2,3), y = apoa4_fabp1$lower_ci, xend = c(1,2,3), yend = apoa4_fabp1$upper_ci) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colours) +
  ylim(c(-0.5, 1))

# and the scatter plots for these
to_cor_plot_ileum <- ileum_metadata
for (i in fa_gois){
  to_cor_plot_ileum[,i] <- unlist(ileum_exprs_all[i, as.character(to_cor_plot_ileum$sampleID)])
}    

p1 <- ggplot(to_cor_plot_ileum, aes(x = Apoc2, y = Apoc3, color = status)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colours) +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm") +
  ggpubr::stat_cor(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~status, scales = "free") +

# Black module i.e. defensins and tan module B cell activation
p2 <- ggplot(to_cor_plot_ileum, aes(x = Apoc2, y = Apoa4, color = status)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colours) +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm") +
  ggpubr::stat_cor(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~status, scales = "free") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p3 <- ggplot(to_cor_plot_ileum, aes(x = Apoa4, y = Fabp1, color = status)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colours) +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm") +
  ggpubr::stat_cor(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~status, scales = "free") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

gridExtra::grid.arrange(p1, apoc2_apoc3_p, p2, apoc2_apoa4_p, p3, apoa4_fabp1_p, nrow = 3)

ggsave(p1, file = "export.dir/apoc2_apoc3.pdf", height = 2.5, width = 5)
ggsave(p2, file = "export.dir/apoc2_apoa4.pdf", height = 2.5, width = 5)
ggsave(p3, file = "export.dir/apoa4_fabp1.pdf", height = 2.5, width = 5)
ggsave(apoc2_apoc3_p + theme(legend.position = "none"), file = "export.dir/apoc2_apoc3_ci.pdf", height = 2.5, width = 2.5)
ggsave(apoc2_apoa4_p + theme(legend.position = "none"), file = "export.dir/apoc2_apoa4_ci.pdf", height = 2.5, width = 2.5)
ggsave(apoa4_fabp1_p + theme(legend.position = "none"), file = "export.dir/apoa4_fabp1_ci.pdf", height = 2.5, width = 2.5)

```

This is really nice as the confidence intervals are non-overlapping so we can conclude a difference in correlation strength in the GF vs others (particularly SPF). Also because this is to do with lipid handling we can get make a link to the liver and maybe that should be the next part. Fabp1 pulls back to the fact that this gene is not recovered in the MM12 in initial analyses.

## Compare correlations

### Black module gois

```{r compare cors, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

spf_samples <- rownames(ileum_metadata[ileum_metadata$status == "SPF" & ileum_metadata$age == "Young",])
mm12_samples <- rownames(ileum_metadata[ileum_metadata$status == "MM12" & ileum_metadata$age == "Young",])
gf_samples <- rownames(ileum_metadata[ileum_metadata$status == "GF" & ileum_metadata$age == "Young",])

# black gois
black_spf_exprs <- na.omit(ileum_exprs_all[black_gois, spf_samples])
black_mm12_exprs <- na.omit(ileum_exprs_all[black_gois, mm12_samples])
black_gf_exprs <- na.omit(ileum_exprs_all[black_gois, gf_samples])

spf_cors <- correlate(t(black_spf_exprs)) %>%
  stretch()
mm12_cors <- correlate(t(black_mm12_exprs)) %>%
  stretch()
gf_cors <- correlate(t(black_gf_exprs)) %>%
  stretch()

spf_graph <- spf_cors %>% 
  filter(abs(r) > 0.5) %>%
  graph_from_data_frame(directed = FALSE)

black_spf_graph <- ggraph(spf_graph, layout = "linear", circular = TRUE) +
  geom_edge_arc(aes(color = r), width = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_node_point(size = 6, color = "black") +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name), repel = TRUE) +
  coord_fixed() +
  scale_edge_color_gradient(low = "snow2", high = "red", limits = c(0.5, 1)) +
  theme_void()

mm12_graph <- mm12_cors %>% 
  filter(abs(r) > 0.5) %>%
  graph_from_data_frame(directed = FALSE)

black_mm12_graph <- ggraph(mm12_graph, layout = "linear", circular = TRUE) +
  geom_edge_arc(aes(color = r), width = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_node_point(size = 6, color = "black") +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name), repel = TRUE) +
  coord_fixed() +
  scale_edge_color_gradient(low = "snow2", high = "red", limits = c(0.5, 1)) +
  theme_void() 

gf_graph <- gf_cors %>% 
  filter(abs(r) > 0.5) %>%
  graph_from_data_frame(directed = FALSE)

black_gf_graph <- ggraph(gf_graph, layout = "linear", circular = TRUE) +
  geom_edge_arc(aes(color = r), width = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_node_point(size = 6, color = "black") +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name), repel = TRUE) +
  coord_fixed() +
  scale_edge_color_gradient(low = "snow2", high = "red", limits = c(0.5, 1)) +
  theme_void() 

gridExtra::grid.arrange(black_spf_graph, black_mm12_graph, black_gf_graph, nrow = 1)

ggsave(black_spf_graph, file = "export.dir/black_module_spf.pdf", height = 2.5, width = 3)
ggsave(black_mm12_graph, file = "export.dir/black_module_mm12.pdf", height = 2.5, width = 3)
ggsave(black_gf_graph, file = "export.dir/black_module_gf.pdf", height = 2.5, width = 3)

```

## Liver gois

The next step is to look at the liver modules in the same way. We have observed that the brown module is not well preserved in MM12 but is well preserved in GF - this module contains genes involved in bile acid processing so could be a nice link to the bile acid transport things seen in the ileum. Examples that are preserved are the magenta module which is a lot of ribosomal proteins so very broad translational function.


```{r liver gois, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

```{r enrichment heatmaps,  echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8.27, fig.height=12, fig.align='center'}
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(viridis)
library(patchwork)

create_summary_heatmap_ggplot <- function(summary_df, tissue_name = "Tissue", top_n = 100) {
  if (nrow(summary_df) == 0) stop("Summary dataframe is empty")
  
  pvalue_matrix <- acast(summary_df, GOterm ~ Module, value.var = "Pvalue", fill = 1)
  pvalue_matrix_log <- -log10(pvalue_matrix)
  
  if (nrow(pvalue_matrix_log) > top_n) {
    top_terms <- names(sort(apply(pvalue_matrix_log, 1, max), decreasing = TRUE)[1:top_n])
    pvalue_matrix_log <- pvalue_matrix_log[top_terms, ]
  }
  
  df_long <- melt(pvalue_matrix_log)
  colnames(df_long) <- c("GOterm", "Module", "logP")
  
  # Convert to character and fix specific term
  df_long$GOterm <- as.character(df_long$GOterm)
  df_long$GOterm[df_long$GOterm == "adaptive immune response based on somatic recombination of immune receptors built from immunoglobula-superamila dovation"] <- "Adaptive Immune Response (Somatic Recombination)"
  
  # Apply proper capitalization
  df_long$GOterm <- tools::toTitleCase(tolower(df_long$GOterm))
  
  df_long$GOterm <- factor(df_long$GOterm, levels = rev(unique(df_long$GOterm)))
  
  p <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Module, y = GOterm, fill = logP)) +
    geom_tile(color = "black", linewidth = 0.1, width = 1, height = 1.3) +
    scale_fill_viridis(
      name = expression(-log[10](italic(p))),
      option = "plasma",
      direction = 1,
      limits = c(0, max(df_long$logP, na.rm = TRUE)),
      oob = scales::squish
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    labs(title = paste(tissue_name, "- GO Term Enrichment by Module"),
         x = "Module", y = "GO Term") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
      panel.spacing = unit(3, "lines")
    )
  
  return(p)
}


ileum_results$summary$GOterm[ileum_results$summary$GOterm == "adaptive immune response based on somatic recombination of immune receptors built from immunoglobulin superfamily domains"] <- "adaptive immune response (somatic recombination)"

p_ileum <- create_summary_heatmap_ggplot(ileum_results$summary, "Ileum")
p_liver <- create_summary_heatmap_ggplot(liver_results$summary, "Liver")

# Combine with larger relative space and exportable layout
combined_plot <- p_ileum / p_liver + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1))

Finally, we wanted to understand how these module eigengenes mapped across cell types. Using the same publicly available single cell dataset used for deconvolution, we projected the module eigengenes onto the single cell data to determine which cell types were likely to present with those co-expression patterns. In the ileum (Fig X), we saw that the immune eigengene was enriched across immune cell types, RNA processing was present across enterocytes and B cylcing cells primarily, whereas sterol and lipid metabolism occured across a lower degree in endothelial cells. In the liver (Fig X), we saw that the immune associated as well as the antigen processing eigengenes were more widely expressed in myeloid cell types, where as cell cycle and lipid metabolic eigengenes were found more in cholangiocytes and endothelial cells

```{r load data single cell ,echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(Seurat)
data <- readRDS('/well/powrie/shared/scrnaseq_shen/whole_final_annotation.rds')

#ILEUM

ileum_sc <- subset(data, subset = tissue == 'ileum')

Idents(ileum_sc) <- ileum_sc@meta.data$celltypes

#LIVER

liver_sc <- subset(data, subset = tissue == 'liver')

Idents(liver_sc) <- liver_sc@meta.data$celltypes

```{r ileum eigengene, echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8.27, fig.height=11.69, fig.align='center'}
ileum_cell_counts <- table(ileum_sc$celltypes)
ileum_celltypes_to_keep <- names(ileum_cell_counts[ileum_cell_counts >= 50])
ileum_sc <- subset(ileum_sc, subset = celltypes %in% ileum_celltypes_to_keep)
# Get the gene names from your WGCNA input data
gene_names_ileum <- colnames(ileum_counts_t_spf)

# Create the mapping
colours_df <- data.frame(
  gene = gene_names_ileum,
  color = mergedColors_spf
)


# Extract genes for each module
magenta_modules <- colours_df[colours_df$color == 'steelblue', ]$gene
lightgreen_modules <- colours_df[colours_df$color == 'turquoise', ]$gene
red_modules <- colours_df[colours_df$color == 'magenta', ]$gene
white_modules <- colours_df[colours_df$color == 'white', ]$gene

# Get assay data
ileum_matrix <- GetAssayData(ileum_sc, layer = 'data', assay = 'RNA')

# Calculate metagenes
magenta_metagene <- colMeans(ileum_matrix[magenta_modules[magenta_modules %in% rownames(ileum_matrix)],])
lightgreen_metagene <- colMeans(ileum_matrix[lightgreen_modules[lightgreen_modules %in% rownames(ileum_matrix)],])
red_metagene <- colMeans(ileum_matrix[red_modules[red_modules %in% rownames(ileum_matrix)],])
white_metagene <- colMeans(ileum_matrix[white_modules[white_modules %in% rownames(ileum_matrix)],])

# Add as metadata
ileum_sc <- AddMetaData(ileum_sc, metadata = magenta_metagene, col.name = 'Immune Eigengene')
ileum_sc <- AddMetaData(ileum_sc, metadata = lightgreen_metagene, col.name = 'RNA Processing Eigengene')

extract_deg <- function(deseq_obj) {
  rownames(deseq_obj$deseq[deseq_obj$deseq$padj < 0.05, , drop = FALSE])
}

ensure_named_colors <- function(colors, mat_t) {
  colors <- as.character(colors)
  if (is.null(names(colors)) || !all(nzchar(names(colors)))) names(colors) <- colnames(mat_t)
  colors
}

deg_fraction <- function(modules_df, color_vec, deg_vec) {
  cols <- as.character(color_vec)
  genes <- names(color_vec)
  sapply(as.character(modules_df$Module), function(m) {
    g <- genes[cols == m]
    if (!length(g)) return(NA_real_)
    mean(g %in% deg_vec)
  })
}

preservation_threshold <- 10

analyze <- function(tbl, z_col, deg_col, threshold) {
  deg <- tbl[[deg_col]]
  z <- tbl[[z_col]]
  preserved <- z >= threshold
  list(
    correlation = suppressWarnings(cor.test(deg, z, method = "spearman")),
    wilcox = suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(deg[preserved], deg[!preserved])),
    summary_stats = list(
      mean_preserved = mean(deg[preserved], na.rm = TRUE),
      median_preserved = median(deg[preserved], na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr_preserved = IQR(deg[preserved], na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_nonpreserved = mean(deg[!preserved], na.rm = TRUE),
      median_nonpreserved = median(deg[!preserved], na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr_nonpreserved = IQR(deg[!preserved], na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )
}

list(
  Ileum_SPF_vs_GF = analyze(preservation_comparison_ileum, "Z_GF", "DEG_frac_SPFvsGF", preservation_threshold),
  Ileum_SPF_vs_MM12 = analyze(preservation_comparison_ileum, "Z_MM12", "DEG_frac_SPFvsMM12", preservation_threshold),
  Liver_SPF_vs_GF = analyze(preservation_comparison_liver, "Z_GF", "DEG_frac_SPFvsGF", preservation_threshold),
  Liver_SPF_vs_MM12 = analyze(preservation_comparison_liver, "Z_MM12", "DEG_frac_SPFvsMM12", preservation_threshold)
)

library(dplyr)

set.seed(42)

get_top_diff_pairs_prefiltered <- function(normed_data, results_list, tissue_prefix, n_pairs = 10000, top_n = 5, pval_cutoff = 0.05, var_cutoff = 0.5) {
  cat("Selecting samples for tissue:", tissue_prefix, "\n")
  spf_samples <- grep(paste0("^", tissue_prefix, "(", paste(1:15, collapse = "|"), ")$"), colnames(normed_data), value = TRUE)
  mm12_samples <- grep(paste0("^", tissue_prefix, "(", paste(61:75, collapse = "|"), ")$"), colnames(normed_data), value = TRUE)
  gf_samples <- grep(paste0("^", tissue_prefix, "(", paste(76:90, collapse = "|"), ")$"), colnames(normed_data), value = TRUE)
  cat(length(spf_samples), "SPF samples,", length(mm12_samples), "MM12 samples,", length(gf_samples), "GF samples selected\n\n")
  
  cat("Processing normalized data for differential gene expression filtering\n")
  normed_processed <- process_deseq_results(as.data.frame(normed_data[, c(spf_samples, mm12_samples, gf_samples)]), offline = TRUE)
  normed_processed <- normed_processed$res[1:(length(normed_processed$res)-1)]
  
  deg_spf_vs_gf <- results_list[[paste0(tissue_prefix, "_SPF_vs_GF")]]$deseq
  deg_spf_vs_mm12 <- results_list[[paste0(tissue_prefix, "_SPF_vs_MM12")]]$deseq
  
  deg_genes_gf <- rownames(deg_spf_vs_gf)[deg_spf_vs_gf$padj < pval_cutoff & !is.na(deg_spf_vs_gf$padj)]
  deg_genes_mm12 <- rownames(deg_spf_vs_mm12)[deg_spf_vs_mm12$padj < pval_cutoff & !is.na(deg_spf_vs_mm12$padj)]
  
  deg_genes <- union(deg_genes_gf, deg_genes_mm12)
  
  genes_in_data <- rownames(normed_processed)
  genes_keep <- intersect(genes_in_data, deg_genes)
  cat(length(genes_keep), "genes pass DEG filtering (padj <", pval_cutoff, ")\n")
  
  # Filter by variance across SPF samples to keep only variable genes
  spf_expr <- normed_processed[genes_keep, spf_samples, drop = FALSE]
  gene_vars <- apply(spf_expr, 1, var)
  genes_var_filtered <- names(gene_vars)[gene_vars >= var_cutoff]
  cat(length(genes_var_filtered), "genes pass variance filtering (var >=", var_cutoff, ")\n\n")
  
  normed_processed_filtered <- normed_processed[genes_var_filtered, ]
  
  spf_expr <- t(normed_processed_filtered[, spf_samples])
  mm12_expr <- t(normed_processed_filtered[, mm12_samples])
  gf_expr <- t(normed_processed_filtered[, gf_samples])
  
  genes <- colnames(spf_expr)
  n_genes <- length(genes)
  cat("Number of genes for correlation analysis after filtering:", n_genes, "\n")
  
  all_possible_pairs <- t(combn(n_genes, 2))
  n_pairs_to_sample <- min(n_pairs, nrow(all_possible_pairs))
  cat("Sampling", n_pairs_to_sample, "gene pairs randomly from all possible pairs\n\n")
  
  sampled_pairs <- all_possible_pairs[sample(nrow(all_possible_pairs), n_pairs_to_sample), , drop = FALSE]
  
  results_df <- data.frame(
    gene1 = genes[sampled_pairs[,1]],
    gene2 = genes[sampled_pairs[,2]],
    cor_spf = numeric(n_pairs_to_sample),
    cor_mm12 = numeric(n_pairs_to_sample),
    cor_gf = numeric(n_pairs_to_sample),
    diff_mm12 = numeric(n_pairs_to_sample),
    diff_gf = numeric(n_pairs_to_sample),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  cat("Calculating correlations for sampled gene pairs...\n")
  pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = n_pairs_to_sample, style = 3)
  for(i in seq_len(n_pairs_to_sample)) {
    g1 <- sampled_pairs[i,1]
    g2 <- sampled_pairs[i,2]
    results_df$cor_spf[i] <- cor(spf_expr[, g1], spf_expr[, g2])
    results_df$cor_mm12[i] <- cor(mm12_expr[, g1], mm12_expr[, g2])
    results_df$cor_gf[i] <- cor(gf_expr[, g1], gf_expr[, g2])
    setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
  }
  close(pb)
  
  results_df$diff_mm12 <- results_df$cor_spf - results_df$cor_mm12
  results_df$diff_gf <- results_df$cor_spf - results_df$cor_gf
  
  cat("Selecting top", top_n, "gene pairs with greatest decrease in correlation for MM12 vs SPF\n")
  top5_mm12 <- results_df %>% arrange(desc(diff_mm12)) %>% head(top_n)
  print(top5_mm12)
  
  cat("\nSelecting top", top_n, "gene pairs with greatest decrease in correlation for GF vs SPF\n")
  top5_gf <- results_df %>% arrange(desc(diff_gf)) %>% head(top_n)
  print(top5_gf)
  
  list(
    top5_mm12 = top5_mm12,
    top5_gf = top5_gf
  )
}

symbol_to_ensembl <- setNames(gene_map$ENSEMBL, gene_map$SYMBOL)

# Main function
make_pair_scatter_with_table <- function(normed_data, tissue_prefix, gene_pairs_df, color_map, top_n = 5) {
  spf_samples <- grep(paste0("^", tissue_prefix, "(", paste(1:15, collapse = "|"), ")$"), colnames(normed_data), value = TRUE)
  mm12_samples <- grep(paste0("^", tissue_prefix, "(", paste(61:75, collapse = "|"), ")$"), colnames(normed_data), value = TRUE)
  gf_samples <- grep(paste0("^", tissue_prefix, "(", paste(76:90, collapse = "|"), ")$"), colnames(normed_data), value = TRUE)

  top_df <- gene_pairs_df[seq_len(min(top_n, nrow(gene_pairs_df))), , drop = FALSE]

  all_rows <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(top_df))) {
    gene1 <- as.character(top_df$gene1[i])
    gene2 <- as.character(top_df$gene2[i])
    g1 <- symbol_to_ensembl[gene1]
    g2 <- symbol_to_ensembl[gene2]
    if (is.na(g1) || is.na(g2)) next
    pair_name <- paste0(gene1, " vs ", gene2)

    make_df <- function(samples, group) {
      data.frame(
        sample = samples,
        group = group,
        gene1 = as.numeric(normed_data[g1, samples]),
        gene2 = as.numeric(normed_data[g2, samples]),
        pair = pair_name,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }

    all_rows[[length(all_rows) + 1]] <- rbind(
      make_df(spf_samples, paste0(tissue_prefix, "_SPF")),
      make_df(mm12_samples, paste0(tissue_prefix, "_MM12")),
      make_df(gf_samples, paste0(tissue_prefix, "_GF"))
    )
  }

  combined_df <- do.call(rbind, all_rows)

  p <- ggplot(combined_df, aes(x = gene1, y = gene2, color = group)) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~pair, scales = "free") +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_map, labels = gsub("_", " ", names(color_map))) +
    labs(
      title = paste(tissue_prefix, "- Gene Pair Correlations"),
      x = "Gene 1 Expression",
      y = "Gene 2 Expression",
      color = "Group"
    ) +
    common_theme

  groups <- unique(combined_df$group)
  pairs <- unique(combined_df$pair)
  r2_mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(groups), ncol = length(pairs),
                   dimnames = list(gsub("_", " ", groups), pairs))

  for (i in seq_along(groups)) {
    for (j in seq_along(pairs)) {
      subset_df <- combined_df[combined_df$group == groups[i] & combined_df$pair == pairs[j], ]
      if (nrow(subset_df) > 1 && all(!is.na(subset_df$gene1)) && all(!is.na(subset_df$gene2))) {
        r2 <- summary(lm(gene2 ~ gene1, data = subset_df))$r.squared
        r2_mat[i, j] <- round(r2, 3)
      }
    }
  }

  r2_df <- as.data.frame(r2_mat)
  r2_df$Group <- rownames(r2_df)
  r2_df <- r2_df[, c("Group", colnames(r2_df)[1:(ncol(r2_df) - 1)])]
  r2_table <- ggtexttable(r2_df, rows = NULL, theme = ttheme("mOrange"))
  r2_table_annotated <- annotate_figure(r2_table, top = text_grob("R² values", face = "bold", size = 20))

  p / r2_table_annotated + plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))
}

# Function to create module validation plots
make_module_validation_scatter <- function(normed_data, tissue_prefix, gene_pairs_df, color_map) {
  spf_samples <- grep(paste0("^", tissue_prefix, "(", paste(1:15, collapse = "|"), ")$"), colnames(normed_data), value = TRUE)
  mm12_samples <- grep(paste0("^", tissue_prefix, "(", paste(61:75, collapse = "|"), ")$"), colnames(normed_data), value = TRUE)
  gf_samples <- grep(paste0("^", tissue_prefix, "(", paste(76:90, collapse = "|"), ")$"), colnames(normed_data), value = TRUE)

  all_rows <- list()
  
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(gene_pairs_df))) {
    gene1_symbol <- gene_pairs_df$gene1[i]
    gene2_symbol <- gene_pairs_df$gene2[i]
    pathway <- gene_pairs_df$pathway[i]
    module_color <- gene_pairs_df$module[i]
    
    # Convert to Ensembl IDs
    g1 <- symbol_to_ensembl[gene1_symbol]
    g2 <- symbol_to_ensembl[gene2_symbol]
    
    if(is.na(g1) || is.na(g2)) {
      cat("Skipping pair", gene1_symbol, "vs", gene2_symbol, "- gene(s) not found\n")
      next
    }
    
    if(!g1 %in% rownames(normed_data) || !g2 %in% rownames(normed_data)) {
      cat("Skipping pair", gene1_symbol, "vs", gene2_symbol, "- gene(s) not in data\n")
      next
    }
    
    pair_name <- paste0(gene1_symbol, " vs ", gene2_symbol, "\n(", pathway, " - ", module_color, " module)")
    
    make_df <- function(samples, group) {
      data.frame(
        sample = samples,
        group = group,
        gene1 = as.numeric(normed_data[g1, samples]),
        gene2 = as.numeric(normed_data[g2, samples]),
        pair = pair_name,
        pathway = pathway,
        module = module_color,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
    
    all_rows[[length(all_rows) + 1]] <- rbind(
      make_df(spf_samples, paste0(tissue_prefix, "_SPF")),
      make_df(mm12_samples, paste0(tissue_prefix, "_MM12")),
      make_df(gf_samples, paste0(tissue_prefix, "_GF"))
    )
  }
  
  if(length(all_rows) == 0) {
    cat("No valid gene pairs found for", tissue_prefix, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  combined_df <- do.call(rbind, all_rows)
  
  # Calculate and print correlations to console
  cat("\n=== Correlation Analysis for", tissue_prefix, "===\n")
  groups <- unique(combined_df$group)
  pairs <- unique(combined_df$pair)
  
  for (pair in pairs) {
    cat("\n--- Gene Pair:", pair, "---\n")
    for (group in groups) {
      subset_df <- combined_df[combined_df$group == group & combined_df$pair == pair, ]
      if (nrow(subset_df) > 1 && all(!is.na(subset_df$gene1)) && all(!is.na(subset_df$gene2))) {
        correlation <- cor(subset_df$gene1, subset_df$gene2)
        r2 <- summary(lm(gene2 ~ gene1, data = subset_df))$r.squared
        cat(sprintf("%s: r = %.3f, R² = %.3f\n", gsub("_", " ", group), correlation, r2))
      }
    }
  }
  cat("\n")
  
  p <- ggplot(combined_df, aes(x = gene1, y = gene2, color = group)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~pair, scales = "free") +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_map, labels = gsub("_", " ", names(color_map))) +
    labs(
      title = paste(tissue_prefix, "- Module Validation"),
      x = "Gene 1 Expression",
      y = "Gene 2 Expression",
      color = "Group"
    ) +
    common_theme
  
  return(p)
}

# Function to extract genes from specific module
extract_module_genes <- function(module_data, module_name = "black") {
  # Assuming module_data has gene assignments
  # This function needs to be adapted based on your module data structure
  module_genes <- module_data[module_data$module == module_name, "gene"]
  return(module_genes)
}

```{r module_validation_updated}
library(dplyr)

# Color palette
spectral <- brewer.pal(11, 'Spectral')
color_map <- c(
  'Liver_GF' = spectral[3],
  'Liver_SPF' = spectral[1],
  'Liver_MM12' = spectral[2],
  'Ileum_GF' = spectral[9],
  'Ileum_SPF' = spectral[11],
  'Ileum_MM12' = spectral[10]
)

# Custom theme
common_theme <- theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
  plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
  plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 20),
  panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1),
  axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 1),
  text = element_text(size = 16),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
  legend.title = element_text(size = 20),
  legend.key.size = unit(0.6, "cm"),
  strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
  legend.position = "bottom"
)

# Gene mapping
all_ensembl_ids <- unique(c(rownames(ileum_normed_dat_corrected), rownames(liver_normed_dat)))
gene_map_raw <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  x = org.Mm.eg.db,
  keys = all_ensembl_ids,
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  columns = c("SYMBOL")
)
gene_map_raw <- gene_map_raw[!is.na(gene_map_raw$SYMBOL), ]
gene_map <- gene_map_raw[!duplicated(gene_map_raw$ENSEMBL), ]
symbol_to_ensembl <- setNames(gene_map$ENSEMBL, gene_map$SYMBOL)
ensembl_to_symbol <- setNames(gene_map$SYMBOL, gene_map$ENSEMBL)

# Function to create module validation plots
make_module_validation_scatter <- function(normed_data, tissue_prefix, gene_pairs_df, color_map) {
  spf_samples <- grep(paste0("^", tissue_prefix, "(", paste(1:15, collapse = "|"), ")$"), colnames(normed_data), value = TRUE)
  mm12_samples <- grep(paste0("^", tissue_prefix, "(", paste(61:75, collapse = "|"), ")$"), colnames(normed_data), value = TRUE)
  gf_samples <- grep(paste0("^", tissue_prefix, "(", paste(76:90, collapse = "|"), ")$"), colnames(normed_data), value = TRUE)

  all_rows <- list()
  
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(gene_pairs_df))) {
    gene1_symbol <- gene_pairs_df$gene1[i]
    gene2_symbol <- gene_pairs_df$gene2[i]
    pathway <- gene_pairs_df$pathway[i]
    module_color <- gene_pairs_df$module[i]
    
    # Convert to Ensembl IDs
    g1 <- symbol_to_ensembl[gene1_symbol]
    g2 <- symbol_to_ensembl[gene2_symbol]
    
    if(is.na(g1) || is.na(g2)) {
      cat("Skipping pair", gene1_symbol, "vs", gene2_symbol, "- gene(s) not found\n")
      next
    }
    
    if(!g1 %in% rownames(normed_data) || !g2 %in% rownames(normed_data)) {
      cat("Skipping pair", gene1_symbol, "vs", gene2_symbol, "- gene(s) not in data\n")
      next
    }
    
    pair_name <- paste0(gene1_symbol, " vs ", gene2_symbol, "\n(", pathway, " - ", module_color, " module)")
    
    make_df <- function(samples, group) {
      data.frame(
        sample = samples,
        group = group,
        gene1 = as.numeric(normed_data[g1, samples]),
        gene2 = as.numeric(normed_data[g2, samples]),
        pair = pair_name,
        pathway = pathway,
        module = module_color,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
    
    all_rows[[length(all_rows) + 1]] <- rbind(
      make_df(spf_samples, paste0(tissue_prefix, "_SPF")),
      make_df(mm12_samples, paste0(tissue_prefix, "_MM12")),
      make_df(gf_samples, paste0(tissue_prefix, "_GF"))
    )
  }
  
  if(length(all_rows) == 0) {
    cat("No valid gene pairs found for", tissue_prefix, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  combined_df <- do.call(rbind, all_rows)
  
  # Calculate and print correlations to console
  cat("\n=== Correlation Analysis for", tissue_prefix, "===\n")
  groups <- unique(combined_df$group)
  pairs <- unique(combined_df$pair)
  
  for (pair in pairs) {
    cat("\n--- Gene Pair:", pair, "---\n")
    for (group in groups) {
      subset_df <- combined_df[combined_df$group == group & combined_df$pair == pair, ]
      if (nrow(subset_df) > 1 && all(!is.na(subset_df$gene1)) && all(!is.na(subset_df$gene2))) {
        correlation <- cor(subset_df$gene1, subset_df$gene2)
        r2 <- summary(lm(gene2 ~ gene1, data = subset_df))$r.squared
        cat(sprintf("%s: r = %.3f, R² = %.3f\n", gsub("_", " ", group), correlation, r2))
      }
    }
  }
  cat("\n")
  
  p <- ggplot(combined_df, aes(x = gene1, y = gene2, color = group)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~pair, scales = "free") +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_map, labels = gsub("_", " ", names(color_map))) +
    labs(
      title = paste(tissue_prefix, "- Module Validation"),
      x = "Gene 1 Expression",
      y = "Gene 2 Expression",
      color = "Group"
    ) +
    common_theme
  
  return(p)
}

# Function to test correlation between two genes
test_gene_correlation <- function(normed_data, gene1_symbol, gene2_symbol, spf_samples) {
  g1 <- symbol_to_ensembl[gene1_symbol]
  g2 <- symbol_to_ensembl[gene2_symbol]
  
  if(is.na(g1) || is.na(g2)) return(NULL)
  if(!g1 %in% rownames(normed_data) || !g2 %in% rownames(normed_data)) return(NULL)
  
  gene1_expr <- as.numeric(normed_data[g1, spf_samples])
  gene2_expr <- as.numeric(normed_data[g2, spf_samples])
  
  if(any(is.na(gene1_expr)) || any(is.na(gene2_expr))) return(NULL)
  
  # Check for zero variance (constant expression)
  if(sd(gene1_expr) == 0 || sd(gene2_expr) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Safely calculate correlation
  correlation <- tryCatch({
    cor(gene1_expr, gene2_expr)
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(NA)
  })
  
  if(is.na(correlation)) return(NULL)
  
  # Safely calculate R²
  r2 <- tryCatch({
    summary(lm(gene2_expr ~ gene1_expr))$r.squared
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(NA)
  })
  
  if(is.na(r2)) return(NULL)
  
  return(list(
    gene1 = gene1_symbol,
    gene2 = gene2_symbol,
    correlation = correlation,
    r2 = r2,
    gene1_expr = gene1_expr,
    gene2_expr = gene2_expr
  ))
}

# Function to find best correlated pair within a pathway (positive correlations only, excludes perfect correlations)
find_best_pair_in_pathway <- function(normed_data, pathway_genes, spf_samples, min_correlation = 0.45) {
  best_correlation <- 0  # Start at 0
  best_pair <- NULL
  
  # Test all pairwise combinations within the pathway
  for(i in 1:(length(pathway_genes)-1)) {
    for(j in (i+1):length(pathway_genes)) {
      result <- test_gene_correlation(normed_data, pathway_genes[i], pathway_genes[j], spf_samples)
      if(!is.null(result) && !is.na(result$correlation) && 
         result$correlation >= min_correlation &&  # POSITIVE correlations only
         result$correlation < 1.0 &&  # EXCLUDE perfect correlations
         result$correlation > best_correlation) {  # Find best positive correlation
        best_correlation <- result$correlation
        best_pair <- result
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(best_pair)
}

# Function to create SPF-only module validation plots with priority and backup searching
make_spf_validation_scatter <- function(normed_data, tissue_prefix, priority_pairs, pathway_genes, min_correlation = 0.45) {
  spf_samples <- grep(paste0("^", tissue_prefix, "(", paste(1:15, collapse = "|"), ")$"), colnames(normed_data), value = TRUE)
  
  final_pairs <- list()
  
  cat("\n=== SPF Validation for", tissue_prefix, "===\n")
  
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(priority_pairs))) {
    pathway <- priority_pairs$pathway[i]
    module_color <- priority_pairs$module[i]
    
    cat("\n--- Pathway:", pathway, "(", module_color, "module) ---\n")
    
    # First try the priority pair (check for perfect correlation)
    priority_result <- test_gene_correlation(
      normed_data, 
      priority_pairs$gene1[i], 
      priority_pairs$gene2[i], 
      spf_samples
    )
    
    if(!is.null(priority_result)) {
      cat(sprintf("Priority pair %s vs %s: r = %.3f, R² = %.3f\n", 
                  priority_result$gene1, priority_result$gene2, 
                  priority_result$correlation, priority_result$r2))
      
      # Only accept positive correlations that meet minimum threshold and are not perfect
      if(priority_result$correlation >= min_correlation && priority_result$correlation < 1.0) {
        cat("✓ Priority pair meets positive correlation threshold (non-perfect) - using this pair\n")
        final_pairs[[pathway]] <- list(
          result = priority_result,
          pathway = pathway,
          module = module_color,
          source = "priority"
        )
        next
      } else if(priority_result$correlation >= 1.0) {
        cat("✗ Priority pair has perfect correlation - searching pathway genes for non-perfect positive correlation...\n")
      } else if(priority_result$correlation < 0) {
        cat("✗ Priority pair has negative correlation - searching pathway genes for positive correlation...\n")
      } else {
        cat("✗ Priority pair below positive correlation threshold - searching pathway genes...\n")
      }
    } else {
      cat("✗ Priority pair not available in data - searching pathway genes...\n")
    }
    
    # Search within pathway genes for better positive correlation (already excludes perfect correlations)
    if(pathway %in% names(pathway_genes)) {
      backup_result <- find_best_pair_in_pathway(normed_data, pathway_genes[[pathway]], spf_samples, min_correlation)
      
      if(!is.null(backup_result)) {
        cat(sprintf("Best backup pair %s vs %s: r = %.3f, R² = %.3f\n", 
                    backup_result$gene1, backup_result$gene2, 
                    backup_result$correlation, backup_result$r2))
        final_pairs[[pathway]] <- list(
          result = backup_result,
          pathway = pathway,
          module = module_color,
          source = "backup"
        )
      } else {
        cat("No suitable backup pairs found in pathway (positive correlations only, excluding perfect correlations)\n")
      }
    }
  }
  
  if(length(final_pairs) == 0) {
    cat("No suitable gene pairs found for", tissue_prefix, "(positive correlations only)\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Create plotting data
  all_rows <- list()
  for(pathway in names(final_pairs)) {
    pair_info <- final_pairs[[pathway]]
    result <- pair_info$result
    
    pair_name <- paste0(result$gene1, " vs ", result$gene2, "\n(", pathway, " - ", pair_info$module, " module)")
    
    spf_df <- data.frame(
      sample = spf_samples,
      gene1 = result$gene1_expr,
      gene2 = result$gene2_expr,
      pair = pair_name,
      pathway = pathway,
      module = pair_info$module,
      correlation = round(result$correlation, 3),
      r2 = round(result$r2, 3),
      source = pair_info$source,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    all_rows[[length(all_rows) + 1]] <- spf_df
  }
  
  combined_df <- do.call(rbind, all_rows)
  
  # Get the appropriate SPF color
  spf_color <- color_map[paste0(tissue_prefix, "_SPF")]
  
  p <- ggplot(combined_df, aes(x = gene1, y = gene2)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, color = spf_color, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = spf_color, linewidth = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~pair, scales = "free") +
    labs(
      title = paste(tissue_prefix, "SPF - Module Validation (Best Positive Correlated Pairs)"),
      x = "Gene 1 Expression",
      y = "Gene 2 Expression",
      caption = paste("Showing gene pairs with", min_correlation, "≤ r < 1.0 (positive correlations only, excluding perfect correlations)")
    ) +
    common_theme
  
  return(p)
}

# Generate validation plots
cat("Generating Ileum SPF module validation plots...\n")
plot_ileum_spf <- make_spf_validation_scatter(
  normed_data = ileum_normed_dat_corrected,
  tissue_prefix = "Ileum",
  priority_pairs = ileum_priority_pairs,
  pathway_genes = ileum_pathway_genes,
  min_correlation = 0.45
)

cat("Generating Liver SPF module validation plots...\n")
plot_liver_spf <- make_spf_validation_scatter(
  normed_data = liver_normed_dat,
  tissue_prefix = "Liver",
  priority_pairs = liver_priority_pairs,
  pathway_genes = liver_pathway_genes,
  min_correlation = 0.45
)

# Print plots
if(!is.null(plot_ileum_spf)) {
  print(plot_ileum_spf)
}

if(!is.null(plot_liver_spf)) {
  print(plot_liver_spf)
}

# Function to create SPF-only module validation plots
make_spf_validation_scatter <- function(normed_data, tissue_prefix, gene_pairs_df) {
  spf_samples <- grep(paste0("^", tissue_prefix, "(", paste(1:15, collapse = "|"), ")$"), colnames(normed_data), value = TRUE)

  all_rows <- list()
  
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(gene_pairs_df))) {
    gene1_symbol <- gene_pairs_df$gene1[i]
    gene2_symbol <- gene_pairs_df$gene2[i]
    pathway <- gene_pairs_df$pathway[i]
    module_color <- gene_pairs_df$module[i]
    
    # Convert to Ensembl IDs
    g1 <- symbol_to_ensembl[gene1_symbol]
    g2 <- symbol_to_ensembl[gene2_symbol]
    
    if(is.na(g1) || is.na(g2)) {
      cat("Skipping pair", gene1_symbol, "vs", gene2_symbol, "- gene(s) not found\n")
      next
    }
    
    if(!g1 %in% rownames(normed_data) || !g2 %in% rownames(normed_data)) {
      cat("Skipping pair", gene1_symbol, "vs", gene2_symbol, "- gene(s) not in data\n")
      next
    }
    
    pair_name <- paste0(gene1_symbol, " vs ", gene2_symbol, "\n(", pathway, " - ", module_color, " module)")
    
    spf_df <- data.frame(
      sample = spf_samples,
      gene1 = as.numeric(normed_data[g1, spf_samples]),
      gene2 = as.numeric(normed_data[g2, spf_samples]),
      pair = pair_name,
      pathway = pathway,
      module = module_color,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    all_rows[[length(all_rows) + 1]] <- spf_df
  }
  
  if(length(all_rows) == 0) {
    cat("No valid gene pairs found for", tissue_prefix, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  combined_df <- do.call(rbind, all_rows)
  
  # Calculate and print correlations to console
  cat("\n=== SPF Correlation Analysis for", tissue_prefix, "===\n")
  pairs <- unique(combined_df$pair)
  
  for (pair in pairs) {
    cat("\n--- Gene Pair:", pair, "---\n")
    subset_df <- combined_df[combined_df$pair == pair, ]
    if (nrow(subset_df) > 1 && all(!is.na(subset_df$gene1)) && all(!is.na(subset_df$gene2))) {
      correlation <- cor(subset_df$gene1, subset_df$gene2)
      r2 <- summary(lm(gene2 ~ gene1, data = subset_df))$r.squared
      cat(sprintf("SPF: r = %.3f, R² = %.3f\n", correlation, r2))
    }
  }
  cat("\n")
  
  # Get the appropriate SPF color for this tissue
  spf_color <- color_map[paste0(tissue_prefix, "_SPF")]
  
  p <- ggplot(combined_df, aes(x = gene1, y = gene2)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, color = spf_color, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = spf_color, linewidth = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~pair, scales = "free") +
    labs(
      title = paste(tissue_prefix, "SPF - Module Validation"),
      x = "Gene 1 Expression",
      y = "Gene 2 Expression"
    ) +
    common_theme
  
  return(p)
}

# Generate validation plots
cat("Generating Ileum SPF module validation plots...\n")
plot_ileum_spf <- make_spf_validation_scatter(
  normed_data = ileum_normed_dat_corrected,
  tissue_prefix = "Ileum",
  gene_pairs_df = ileum_gene_pairs
)

# Print plots

  print(plot_ileum_spf)
}

  print(plot_liver_spf)
}
